text.value: Laboratory Report

tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The findings indicate a urinary tract infection (UTI) with significant bacteriuria (E. coli >100,000 CFU/mL), marked leukocyturia, positive nitrites, hematuria, and leukocyte esterase. The low specific gravity may reflect dilute urine. No casts were seen, suggesting infection is likely limited to the lower urinary tract. Clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy are recommended.
